title: Why Malls? What age?
content: Just stumbled onto this today after spending the last two weeks listing all my dreamscapes. Which is weird because i wasnt looking for this and basically come to reddit for seinfeld memes. Im 42 years old and my dream mall is a huge complex i visited in Vegas but each floor is various shopping malls from my life. Its not an important space in my dreams, but it does recur. Its curious that mallworld became the common name for these locations, or is that just the idea of the mods here and hasnt actually caught on outside of here? I'm wondering about this and age because when i was a kid i thought shopping malls always existed, but in the 80s they were relatively new, and through the 90s they were massively popular hangouts. And only a few decades later teens no longer go. Malls are basically dying spaces. TL;DR I wonder if malls are more prevalent in the dreams of genX and millenials.
